title: Record the promotion read-back and the conflicted-PR CI behavior in the profile
description: The 2026-09-30 promotion (PR opum-ai/glyph-cli#17) took dev to main at 4069c19 with refs/heads/dev surviving and no recreate - the first promotion under DEC-70's default-branch change, so OPAG-844's fix is confirmed. Two measured facts are not yet in the repository profile: the promotion paragraph still says the fix is untested, and the CI paragraph does not say that a CONFLICTING pull request receives no pull_request workflow runs at all (which cost this session several pushing cycles: pushes and reopens produced no CI until the conflict was resolved; runs resumed on the conflict-resolving push).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The profile promotion paragraph records that the 2026-09-30 promotion read refs/heads/dev back clean with no recreate
The profile CI paragraph states that a conflicted pull request receives no pull_request workflow runs until the conflict is resolved

implementationNotes: FINAL: both measured facts are in the profile.
